top_signals.title: 3X Commodity ETFs: 'SEC Giving Market What It Wants'
top_signals.summary: Cinthia Murphy, investment strategist at TMX Vettafi, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss multifactor fund resurgence, buybacks, and the recent approval from the SEC for certain commodity 3X ETFs. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: How Invesco Fights Off 'QQQ' Competition
top_signals.summary:
Brian Hartigan, global head of ETFs and index Strategies at Invesco, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss recent competition centered on the Invesco QQQ Trust Series 1 (ticker: QQQ).
 (Source: Bloomberg)
